title: Wire core/learning/completion_constants.dart's kBulkPriorSentinelMs into its would-be callers instead of leaving it dead and re-duplicated 3x
rule: Fowler-duplication / Evans (invariant re-derived instead of enforced in one place)

evidence.quote: These constants are used across domain services and providers to identify
core→features layering violation and is the single source of truth for the

why: completion_constants.dart's docstring claims kBulkPriorSentinelMs is 'used across domain services and providers,' but a repo-wide grep shows zero imports of this file anywhere in lib/ or test/ — it is dead code. Meanwhile SchedulerEngine, BulkPriorCompletionService, and StreakRestorer each independently hand-redefine the identical magic literal 946684800000 (DateTime.utc(2000,1,1)). Two of the three duplicate definitions explicitly self-describe as 'the single source of truth,' a direct contradiction between files. All copies currently agree, so there is no live bug today, but the sentinel governs whether a completion counts toward streak/daily-bar-chart 'live activity' — if any one of the 4 independent copies is ever edited (e.g. during the W3.27-style migrations already underway elsewhere in this codebase) without updating the others, gamification data would silently miscategorize bulk-imported completions as live activity or vice versa for affected users, with no compiler or test signal since nothing imports the canonical constant to compare against.
recommendation: Pick one true source (core/learning/completion_constants.dart is the natural core-layer home) and have SchedulerEngine, BulkPriorCompletionService, and StreakRestorer import and reuse it; if a core→features layering constraint genuinely blocks that, document why in coding-standards.md and delete the now-provably-false 'used across... providers' claim from whichever copy remains a local duplicate.
acceptance_criteria: grep for the literal 946684800000 (or DateTime.utc(2000, 1, 1) used as a sentinel) outside test/ resolves to exactly one definition plus its importers, not 4 independent literals.
core/learning/completion_constants.dart's docstring claim is verifiably true (has real importers) or the file is removed.

Existing bulk-prior/streak/scheduler regression tests continue passing after de-duplication (points_service_test.dart, chart_data_service tests, streak tests already reference the sentinel and act as the regression check).

corrections: bulk_prior_completion_service.dart quote is at line 29, not 27; streak_restorer.dart quote is at line 44, not 46. Substance otherwise confirmed exact at all other cited lines.
